caption: The drawing depicts a metallic stove that is dark gray to black in color, featuring ornate, intricate floral and geometric patterns on its surface. The stove has a cylindrical main body positioned vertically, with two rectangular doors on the front side—each door containing its own decorative motifs and a visible handle. The top of the stove appears flat, with a small circular opening or flange on one side, possibly for attaching a pipe. Supporting the stove are four curving legs, which are also made of metal and have a stylized, scroll-like design. Attached to the side of the stove, there is a large, flat, oval-shaped metal plate or shelf. The entire object sits within a simple rectangular border drawn in light red or sepia. In the bottom left corner, there is a small schematic sketch of the stove in the same border color, showing arrows to indicate its dimensions. On the bottom right, there is hand-written text stating "Vincent P. Noel" and additional smaller notations. The background is plain and off-white, with some discoloration at the edges of the paper.
title: Franklin Baking Oven
